section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch10 — Creativity & Thinking (Complete)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Research on creativity generally shows that beyond a certain threshold level, further increases in intelligence (IQ) do NOT necessarily lead to proportionally greater creativity. This finding is best described by the:

options.option_text: Threshold theory of creativity and intelligence

explanation: The threshold theory holds that a minimum level of intelligence is necessary for creativity, but above that threshold, intelligence and creativity are only weakly correlated.
